newsitem.title: USA: California rapist sentenced to 305 years in prison.
newsitem.headline: California rapist sentenced to 305 years in prison.

text.p: A California man was sentenced Tuesday to 305 years in prison for a series of brutal rapes.
Barry Dwayne Jones, 34, was sentenced to 12 consecutive sentences of 25 years plus an additional five years following his conviction in July for three rapes and other crimes.
Jones faced sentencing under California's "three strikes" law, which mandates stiff sentences for repeat offenders.
He had pleaded not guilty to the crimes.

Before sentencing in San Jose by Superior Court Judge Daniel Creed, Jones alleged police, prosecutors and his own attorney were involved in a cover-up. He alleged the all-white jury was racially biased against him because he is black.
Prosecutor Raymundo Mendoza said he was satisfied with the sentence. He described Jones as a "monster" and a "predator."

Authorities said the so-called "Berryessa Rapist" broke into the homes of women and tied them up, sometimes while small children were present in the house. He raped the women and then stole cash and jewelry from their homes.
He was dubbed the "Berryessa Rapist" because the crimes occurred in the Berryessa district along the San Jose-Milpitas border in early 1995.
When he was arrested, Jones was wearing a watch identified by one of the victims as belonging to her husband.
